PDF-Lib 1.17.1, MIT licensed. Vendored UMD browser distribution.

Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pdf-lib@1.17.1/dist/pdf-lib.min.js
Upstream: https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib/tree/v1.17.1

Used by the application PDF export worker to copy complete pages into one PDF.
The runtime uses this local copy; no documents are sent to an external service.
